message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV/TSV files and passes them directly to model pipelines without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local file paths only (e.g., 'data/train.tsv', 'data/test_stg2.tsv') with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or authentication present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are instantiated directly (LGBMRegressor, Keras Model, etc.) and vectorizers are loaded via pickle without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks label distribution, class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in any of the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation enforcement, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and the evaluation path (my_evaluate) uses the full training data X without a separate protected split; no integrity controls exist.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads CSVs and passes DataFrames directly to model.predict() with no shape, range, schema, or null checks performed beforehand.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions are rounded and written to CSV without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds applied to the model's output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used (LightGBM, neural network, ridge regression) are not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
